extracted.title: 2026 FunFest: A Night at the Museum
extracted.notes:
Calling all curious kiddos, playful parents, and thrill-seeking families, FunFest: A Night at the Museum is your golden ticket to an after-hours adventure where the museum turns into your playground!

Explore mind-blowing exhibits, gobble up delicious treats, and dive into fantastically fun activities that spark the imagination. Grown-ups can unwind with a cocktail in hand while the kids engage in play zones thoughtfully designed exclusively for FunFest—or take part themselves!

FunFest is a fundraiser and "friend-raiser" supporting The Franklin Institute's education programs and discounted/free tickets for students and teachers.

## Good to Know

- Children 2 and under are free; children 3+ require a ticket.
- Food throughout the museum, including kid-friendly bites, dinner stations, and an open bar with specialty cocktails for adults.
- Complimentary self-parking at the Franklin Institute garage (271 N. 21st Street) for tickets taken after 4:30pm.
- Coat check and stroller-friendly; dress casually with comfortable shoes.
- Tickets available at the door at the registration desk.
